title: /v1 record ETag covers the whole editable record: a second PATCH with the same If-Match after a title change is 412 REVISION_STALE, nothing written
steps: S1: recordRevision over a record: reorder keys, CRLF, NFD, a number as text, comment_count; then change title, content, excerpt, status, slug.
S2: With a fake WordPress plugin 0.17.0: GET the record's ETag, PATCH post_title with If-Match = that tag, then PATCH again with the SAME tag.
S3: Change the body after the GET (at Tracy's read, and only at the plugin's lock) and PATCH with the old tag.
expect: S1: the normalisations and comment_count leave the revision unchanged; every editable field moves it; no body_revision → no revision.
S2: first PATCH 200; second 412 error.code REVISION_STALE with the current ETag; no second content.update sent; the title stays the first write's.
S3: both 412 REVISION_STALE in one wording; the write carried expected_body_revision of Tracy's read.

tests: GET /v1 record: the ETag covers the whole record
🔒 J13.2: a second PATCH with the same If-Match after a TITLE change
🔒 PATCH /v1 record whose If-Match no longer names the body: 412
🔒 PATCH /v1 record: a body write that lands between the read and the plugin’s lock
